# Change log

## Reference extension — four increments A–D (2026-10-18)

Added the host-controlled governed interface, strictly proposed semantic annotations, source-byte preservation, independent verifier plugin allowlist, correction and historical delivery ledger, transitive invalidation, ambiguity and dictionary source references, perspectives, anomaly research queue, hash-linked local event log, optional loopback Ollama JSON proposal client and deterministic bridge. Updated docs and expanded regression suite. See `RELEASE_AUDIT.md` for exact local test results and known limitations.

## Baseline truth-accountability-reference (2026-10-18)

Initial small legacy example `TruthLedger` with 17 deterministic unit tests and an integration proposal. Retained for backwards compatibility, not as an alternative authority path.

## 2026-10-18 — Increment E: Version 1 adapter staging (standalone)

- Added a fail-closed read-only archive/directory inspector requiring an explicit corpus field mapping before 2,000-entry inspection and contextual retrieval; no source code imports or ZIP extraction.
- Added a single host-gated contextual inference route, bounded advisory contexts and a known-risk block for unsupported inferred mental-state hypotheses.
- Expanded lexical risk detection for several additional morphological variants; heuristics remain incomplete by design.
- Added mock/replay/live-local Ollama evaluation runner with 24 developer-authored synthetic cases and SHA-bound reports; no live local model available in the execution environment.
- Documented discovered but raw-byte-inaccessible Version 1 Library source and deferred conformance status. Neither existing Version 1 nor Project-AI was modified.

## 2026-10-18 — Increment F (owner source binding, security fixes)

- Verified owner-supplied canonical Version 1 ZIP, SHA-256 and original 440 tests; mapped actual 2,000 entry JSONL and ran `SocietalReasoner.assess_text`/`review_draft` with source-bound receipts.
- Added `Version1RuntimeAdvisor` in the one host-gated societal pipeline; on malformed original-source results or review findings, withhold the response.
- Added row fingerprint seals for decision-critical records and unsealed-row detection; decision paths and writes now fail closed on audit corruption. Optional externally held HMAC audit key and external anchor comparison support independent host protections.
- Corrected four independently reported defects: check-verdict mutation, check policy downgrade, withdrawn-claim correction deletion, and speculative person-motive hypothesis escaping the model bridge. Unreviewed hypotheses are now held by default; trusted host may explicitly review research hypotheses.
- Added source-bound integration demonstration, nine source tests, expanded hostile regressions and explicit compatibility note for old unsealed ledger DBs.
- Updated mock case S16 to expect the stricter held-hypothesis outcome. This is an intentional policy change, not a claim of unchanged behavior.
- Kept original Version 1 source, Project-AI, repository branches and publication status unchanged.
